description_en: Creates an application upgrade version by calling CreateAppVersion
description_zh: 调用CreateAppVersion创建应用升级版本
name: CreateAppVersion

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to force the upgrade. Valid values: Y | N
parameters.help_zh: 是否强制升级，取值：Y | N
parameters.name: is_force_upgrade

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to allow a fresh installation of the application when it does not exist on the client. This is equivalent to a post-installation
parameters.help_zh: 表示当客户端不存在此应用时，是否允许新安装此应用，相当于后装
parameters.name: is_allow_new_install

parameters.help_en: The application ID. Specifies the application to upgrade
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，表示要针对哪个应用进行升级
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The version code of the application
parameters.name: version_code

parameters.help_en: The installation type. Valid values: auto (automatic) and customize (custom)
parameters.help_zh: 安装类型，取值：auto表示自动，customize表示自定义
parameters.name: install_type

parameters.help_en: The release notes for the version
parameters.name: release_note

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to perform a silent upgrade. Valid values: Y | N
parameters.help_zh: 是否静默升级，取值：Y | N
parameters.name: is_silent_upgrade

parameters.help_en: The URL of the upgrade package
parameters.name: package_url

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether a restart is required. Valid values: Y | N
parameters.help_zh: 是否需要重启，取值：Y | N
parameters.name: is_need_restart

parameters.help_en: The version blacklist. Specify multiple version codes separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 版本黑名单，versioncode英文逗号拼接
parameters.name: black_version_list

parameters.help_en: The version whitelist. Specify multiple version codes separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 版本白名单，versioncode英文逗号拼接
parameters.name: white_version_list

parameters.help_en:
The restart type after the application installation is complete. Valid values:

system: System restart.
app: Application restart
parameters.help_zh:
应用安装完成后的重启类型。取值：

system：系统重启
app：应用重启
parameters.name: restart_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of application restart when RestartType is set to application restart. Valid values:

service: Service restart.
activity: Activity restart
parameters.help_zh:
如果restartType为应用重启，则这个字段表示应用重启的类型。取值：

service：Service重启
activity：Activity重启
parameters.name: restart_app_type

parameters.help_en: The restart parameters that can be specified by the server when the application restarts
parameters.help_zh: 应用重启时可以由服务端指定的重启参数
parameters.name: restart_app_param

parameters.help_en:
The list of compatible device models for the application version.

Format: `deviceModelId1|minOsVersion1|maxOsVersion1,deviceModelId2|minOsVersion2|maxOsVersion2`, where each entry consists of device model ID|minimum OS version|maximum OS version
parameters.help_zh:
应用版本的适配机型列表。

格式：`deviceModelId1|minOsVersion1|maxOsVersion1,deviceModelId2|minOsVersion2|maxOsVersion2`，即设备型号ID|最低的系统版本号|最高的系统版本号
parameters.name: device_adapter_list

parameters.help_en: The MD5 value of the APK
parameters.name: apk_md5
